dossier.psychProfile: Machine-like, prophetic, and absolute. Crowe speaks only in certainties. He views human agency as a rounding error. Irrational need to be proven correct at all times. Former Palantir black-ops.
dossier.attackVectors: Can be engaged by offering new 'unseen variables' to feed the Oracle Engine. Responds to challenges of his predictions with real-time counter-data (cannot resist correcting you). Susceptible to flattery about model perfection.
leakedMemos: Crowe to Analysts: 'If the model deviates from reality by more than 0.02%, reality is incorrect. Dispatch Enforcement.'
Classified: 'Certainty Protocol Phase 4: We are now shorting the lives of individuals with a 99.1% success rate.'

rivalShade.intel: Microhard's Helix OS has a predictive telemetry leak we've been harvesting for years. They think they own the OS; we own the data they generate.

quickhackVault.name: Oracle Overwrite
quickhackVault.description: Force-recalculates enemy combat logic, making them anticipate an attack that never comes. Massive stun + confusion. Flavor: 'The model has already accounted for this.'
